// diagnostic

E0160

`++` and `--` are not Jet operators.

What

`++` and `--` are not Jet operators.

Why

Jet updates a number with compound assignment only; an update hidden inside an expression reads one value and stores another.

Fix

Write `x += 1` or `x -= 1` as its own statement; inside an expression, move the update into its own statement before or after the use.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0160: tests/ui/incr_retired_double_minus.stderr.

Error [E0160]: `--` is not a Jet operator
  --> tests/ui/incr_retired_double_minus.jet:4:14
    |
  4 |     print("{a--b}")
    |              ^^
 Why: Jet retired `++` and `--`; reading `a--b` as `a - -b` would hide a sign inside an operator
 Fix: Write `a - -b` with a space, or `a - b` if one sign was meant
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0160
